name: lifeos
description: Capture thoughts and meeting evidence locally, organize Things, and plan time through Apple Calendar.

interface.shortDescription: Capture thoughts, debrief meetings, and plan reviewed work.
interface.longDescription: LifeOS preserves brain dumps and meeting evidence locally, turns them into reviewable candidate work, and coordinates approved changes with Things and Apple Calendar.
defaultPrompt: Brain dump this and sort the useful parts without creating tasks yet.
I just had a meeting. Use the transcript to extract only my own follow-up tasks, verify ownership against the notes, and route each task to the right LifeOS area.
Read my captured thoughts and help me turn the actionable ones into a reviewed plan.
